name: snapchat-mcp
description: Snapchat Ads (Snapchat Ads Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resu

platform_mcp_snapchat_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_snapchat_client_id.description: OAuth client id of your Snap Business Manager app (Business Details > OAuth apps).

platform_mcp_snapchat_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_snapchat_client_secret.description: The OAuth app's client secret (form body of the refresh request).

platform_mcp_snapchat_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_snapchat_refresh_token.description: Refresh token from one authorization-code consent with scope snapchat-marketing-api (https://developers.snap.com/api/marketing-api/Ads-API/authentication); 60-minute access tokens are minted from it.

platform_mcp_snapchat_organization_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_ORGANIZATION_ID
platform_mcp_snapchat_organization_id.description: Snap organization id whose ad accounts list_accounts returns (GET /v1/me/organizations).

platform_mcp_snapchat_ad_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_snapchat_ad_account_id.description: Ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /v1/adaccounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).

platform_mcp_snapchat_tz_offset.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_TZ_OFFSET
platform_mcp_snapchat_tz_offset.description: UTC offset of the ad account time zone, e.g. -07:00 or +01:00, used to build day-aligned start_time/end_time for get_report (Snap requires daily boundaries in the account time zone).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/me: the authenticated Snap user {me: {id, email, organization_id, display_name}}.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /v1/organizations/{organization_id config}/adaccounts: the organization's ad accounts (currency and timezone per account).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /v1/adaccounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns?limit= (50-1000; first page only, paging.next_link). Budgets are micro-currency: budget_micros is daily_budget_micro (1,000,000 = 1 unit of the account currency). `status` (ACTIVE, PAUSED) is not a filter.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /v1/campaigns/{campaign_id}/stats?granularity=DAY&fields=impressions,swipes,spend with start_time/end_time at midnight in the account time zone (tz_offset config). campaign_id is required. end_time is an exclusive day boundary: pass date_to as the day AFTER the last day wanted. spend is micro-currency; metrics are final 48 hours after the day ends.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PATCH /v1/adaccounts/{ad_account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} (application/json-patch+json) [{op: replace, path: /status, value: PAUSED|ACTIVE}]. Resuming restarts spending.
